topic: What if Luffy had been in the Marines when Sabo's ship was destroyed
title: Luffy Wasn't There When Sabo Died (One Piece 585)
description: In chapter 585, Luffy and Ace watched Sabo's ship destroyed. What if Luffy had been away in the Marines, and Ace carried it alone? Full breakdown on the channel: What If Luffy Joined The Marines?
comment: Would Luffy have forgiven the Marines if he'd learned about Sabo later? Pick one.

lines.text: Luffy was on that shore when Sabo's ship was destroyed. What if he wasn't?

lines.text: Chapter 585. A Celestial Dragon fires a cannon at a boat carrying a boy who just wanted to be free.

shot.fallback: anime style sabo ship celestial dragon cannon, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Now take Luffy out. In this timeline, Garp took him to Marine headquarters before it happened.

shot.fallback: anime style garp luffy marine headquarters, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Ace stands on the shore alone, and nobody tells Luffy for months.

shot.fallback: anime style ace alone shore sabo, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: People say Luffy would just forgive the Marines, because he doesn't hold grudges. But this is Sabo.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy sabo brothers, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: So here's my read. The Marines don't break Luffy here, they lose him right here.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy leaves marines, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And that's the twist. Luffy's anger at the Marines doesn't start at Marineford. It starts with a ship he never saw burn.
